title: CVH Copilot (Sidecar Architect Dock) in React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4
summary: Built the sleek, tactile 'CVH Copilot' (Sidecar Architect Dock) in React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4 adhering strictly to the White Paper / Vercel design system. Implemented Zustand reactive copilotStore with bidirectional Tauri v2 IPC streaming and offline fallback simulation, resizable right sidecar dock (320-650px), header bar with Bot icon + purple [АРХИТЕКТОР] badge, model selector pill, [Очистить чат] with 2-click confirmation, auto-scrolling feed, lightweight MarkdownContent renderer, collapsible ThinkingCard with live pulse badge, ToolExecutionCard with runtime duration and status badges, steer bar with auto-expanding textarea, Enter to submit, Shift+Enter for newline, Topbar [🤖 Архитектор] toggle button, and Ctrl+B / Cmd+B keyboard shortcut.
commitMessage: feat(ui): implement CVH Copilot Sidecar Architect Dock with Zustand store
author: Lead UI Artisan (react-tailwind-artisan)
